title: Per-account netGuaranteed is floored against the GLOBAL share balance while grossToRequest is capped per account, so N clients are each quoted a floor only one can be paid
description: The market override caps grossToRequest per account (against clientBalances) but floors netGuaranteed against the strategy's GLOBAL vault share balance (_exitFloor at :130); the base default has the same shape at AYieldStrategy.sol:583. The shared, unreserved vault position is quoted in full to every client independently, so the sum of outstanding guarantees can exceed the position that backs them.
impact: N clients are each quoted a floor only one can be paid. PoC: two 980.1e18 floors against a 1000e18 position (sum = 1.96x); the second client receives 20e18 (2.0% of its quote) and is debited its FULL 990e18 via the protocol-favouring write-down at AYieldStrategy.sol:781-783. Three-client invariant run: sum netGuaranteed 30,000e18 vs realizable 26,730e18 (+12.2%), and NOT an artifact of the mock's redemption throttle (v2_shortfallUnthrottled 387 direct / 108 market). What is filed is the over-issued guarantee — a view that legitimises an FCFS drain by telling each client it will be paid.
attackPath: Two or more clients are authorized on the same strategy and share one commingled vault position.
Each STATICCALLs previewExitFor and receives a floor computed against the whole position.
The first client to execute consumes the shared shares.
The second client's withdraw delivers a fraction of its quote and debits it in full at :781-783.
recommendation: Either apportion the shared cap (floor each client's quote against its pro-rata claim on the position rather than the global balance) or state explicitly in the NatSpec that the floor is NON-EXCLUSIVE and only holds for the first exiter in a block. Do not add a per-client cap on the commingled position itself — the commingled share cap is by design (minter-cushion memo).
suppressedLeg: The STANDALONE client-vs-client value transfer is suppressed under the minter-cushion memo — PhusdStableMinter has no strategy-withdraw path and cannot race, so no per-client cap is recommended. Scope accepted exactly as dedup framed it and NOT widened. Only the over-issued guarantee is filed.
